titel: Why Your Bunny Hates Being Picked Up

beats.say: Why does your bunny kick and run... every time you *pick it up?*
Because to a rabbit, being lifted feels like one thing: a *hawk* grabbing it.
So Rudi lifts it super gently, on a fluffy *pillow.* The bunny launches off like a rocket.
The pillow didn't work. So Rudi builds a *bunny lift.* The bunny hides in a box.
Rabbits are prey animals. Up in the air, they *can't run.*
Bunnies that get picked up a lot... come to their owners *less.*
And that viral trick, bunny on its back? It's not relaxed. It's *playing dead.*
Instead, sit on the floor... and let your bunny come to *you.*
And if your friend says their bunny hates cuddles, just ask...
